items.text: Starting a new career after 50 or 60 works best when you build on decades of experience through consulting, part-time roles, training, mentoring or a small business, learn only the tools you need and plan around health, income and family needs.
Name the problems you already solve, test one paid option, learn the necessary tools and keep your pension or savings safe.
Check them before you commit money or sign agreements.
